method_note: The Census address and coordinate batch services return state/county/tract/block codes, not incorporated-place geography. Original property facts are retained. Supplemental NJ parcel review uses exact complete PROP_LOC addresses and agreeing municipal code/name from the official OGIS/MOD-IV layer; ambiguous or endpoint-only matches remain unresolved. Original Census rows are preserved.
